versions.changelog:
Introduces a LinkedIn profile optimization skill focused on clearer positioning and better profile conversion.

- Audits headline, banner, photo, About, Featured, and Experience.
- Scores profile elements and prioritizes the top three fixes with ready-to-use rewrites.
- Requires the Taplio MCP; uses account settings and peer benchmarks to inform recommendations.
- Requires users to provide profile content, since the MCP cannot read or edit LinkedIn profiles.
